x_guidance:
Foxcite is an AI-native SEO and brand visibility platform.
It helps you monitor how brands are cited and perceived across AI search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity).

Discovery:
- OpenAPI is the source of truth for what can be invoked. Fetch /openapi.json.
- For POST/PUT/PATCH routes, use requestBody.application/json with the schema in the OpenAPI document.

Auth and Payments:
- SIWX (identity-only) routes use the SIGN-IN-WITH-X header. If you receive a 401, sign the challenge provided in the 'x-siwx-challenge' header and retry.
- Payable routes use the x402 protocol. Call the route without payment to receive a 402 challenge, pay the fee on the Base network, and retry with the transaction hash in the 'x-payment-token' header.
- Use /credits/recharge to fund background scans. 1 USDC = 100 credits.

Sequence of Operations:
1. Identify Brand: GET /brands (SIWX required)
2. Run Audit: POST /quick-audit (x402 required)
3. Enable Tracking: POST /brands/{brand_id}/toggle-query-tracking (SIWX required)
4. Recharge: POST /credits/recharge (x402 required)
